notes.base_year: FY2026 (ended 31.7.2026) actual: revenue 11,480 (release 1.9.2026), incl. CyberArk from 11.2.2026 and Chronosphere from Jan 2026 (930 of revenue). Pro forma combined FY26 12,312 (10-K). FY27 guide 14,100-14,200 = +23.3% reported, ~+15% on pro forma
notes.margin: op margin after SBC = non-GAAP op margin - SBC-related charges. FY26 (3,356-1,712)/11,480 = 14.3% (Q4 15.4%). FY27 guide non-GAAP 29.5% minus SBC ~15% (full-year CyberArk replacement awards) = 14.5%; base +1.5-2pt/yr to 21.5% by FY32 (non-GAAP ~33%, SBC ~11.5%)
notes.net_cash: 31.7.2026: cash 2,514 + ST 557 + LT investments 4,835 = 7,906 minus CyberArk 2030 converts at fair value 1,774 = 6,132; FY27 cash deals (Console 500, Embrace) as a charge in year 0
notes.shares: 818M outstanding 31.8.2026 (10-K cover); FY27 guide 844-847M diluted -> 846; SBC expensed in the margin, shares held flat (buybacks offset issuance)
notes.conv: FCF after SBC (cash-flow SBC 1,774) less after-tax interest / NOPAT: FY26 2,079/1,250 = 1.66; FY27 guide (38% adj FCF) ~1.8; FY28 40% adj FCF target ~1.85; fades to 1.45 as deferred-revenue growth slows and annual billing rises (30% of bookings)
notes.beta: 2-year weekly vs SPY (IBKR, 105 weeks) raw 1.48 -> adjusted 1.32
notes.tax: non-GAAP long-term rate ~22% (history lane CALC); cash taxes only $199M in FY26 (deductible CyberArk goodwill) -> the cash advantage sits in conv
notes.charges: FY27 cash deals Embrace 325 + Console 500, IBM QRadar contingent consideration 206 -> 1,000 in year 0
notes.pe: lean_model P/E is on after-SBC operating EPS. PANW own forward non-GAAP P/E median Nov-2021..Jul-2026 = 48x (p25 41, p75 53; IBKR monthly closes / release non-GAAP EPS, CALC). Non-GAAP/after-SBC EPS ratio ~1.53 at FY32 -> 48x = ~73x after SBC. Ours: base 45 (~29x non-GAAP: growth decelerates to ~10%), bear 25 (~16x, Check Point/Cisco-like de-rating), bull 60 (~39x). Calibrated lens: own median 73 (today 147x after SBC / 75.6x non-GAAP is not credible to hold)
notes.growth: FY27 at guide midpoint (+23.3% reported; ~+15% on pro forma 12,312). Base FY28 +15% (consensus 16.23B = +14.5%, AV 47 analysts), then 13.5/12/11/10. Bull = FY30 $20B NGS ARR target path (+19/18/16/14/12) plus a 1.5% beat in FY27 (revenue beat the guide midpoint by +1.1% on average over 8 quarters). Bear = organic decel to high single digits after the firewall refresh and platformization incentives, bundling by Microsoft/hyperscalers, identity slowing toward Okta-like growth: +10/7/6/5/5

calibrated.why: today's 147x after-SBC (75.6x non-GAAP) cannot be held 5 years; PANW's own forward non-GAAP median 48x converted to the after-SBC basis at FY32 (x1.53)
